verdict_text:
YES

The visible logic matches the specification. The projection regex under `fullmatch` selects exactly the 7 matrices per layer for 16 layers, casting them with `.to(torch.bfloat16)` after a no-op `.float()` on already-float32 input. The buffer regex contains `(?!)`, which can never match, so nothing is dropped, and every other tensor passes through as float32 with unchanged values and names. All four required checks are asserted before writing.

One caveat: sharding (256 MiB limit, oversized tensors alone in their shard, and the `model.safetensors.index.json` weight map) is delegated to `save_sharded_safetensors` in an unshown `_ckpt` module, so that part cannot be verified from this artifact alone.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
